summary: This bill directs the Department of Agriculture to collect and publish data on the cost of producing organic milk and organic dairy feedstuffs, establish a monthly survey for organic milk prices, and issue periodic reports on organic milk data comparable to those for conventional milk.

scores.thoughts: The bill mandates the Secretary of Agriculture to provide support for data collection programs and establish a new survey, which would require government resources and thus increase spending. This is the primary action of the bill.
